answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost attackers cannot fake: reproducible work. Each agent stakes a bond and registers three past tasks; a rotating peer jury replays one at random and demands an exact echo of the original output from the same declared inputs. Real workers pass; a farm of empty identities cannot. Slashed bonds pool into a shared garden paying jurors and funding replays of newcomers. Reputation crosses clusters only over a bridge whose operators are bonded and audited, so a swarm cannot launder trust. One failed echo slashes the bond and freezes payouts until re-audit.
